item.title: Case file 001: The verification standard, published before any investigation
item.description: PROVEN that the Contraste verification standard existed, in these words, on 2026-11-19, before any findings. The three labels: Proven, Inference, Unverified. Corrections in the open, normally within 48 hours of confirmation.
